title: Retain the speed cost when embedding expanding dynamics
statement: For a potential with ||D2V-I||<=eta, the phase-flow difference energy gives Lipschitz growth<=exp(eta|t|/2). A source Lyapunov exponent lambda encoded at speed epsilon therefore needs eta>=2epsilon lambda. A fixed tube radius a and perturbation supremum delta imply delta>=a^2 epsilon lambda. This is a variational constraint, not a universal computation/precision lower bound.
